items.question: 1. What can I book through the booking portal?
items.answer: You can use the platform to book various rooms, equipment and resources provided by the City of Guben, such as event spaces, technical equipment or municipal facilities.

items.question: 2. Who can use the booking portal?
items.answer: The service is intended for residents, clubs, schools and other organizations connected with the City of Guben.

items.question: 3. Do I have to register to make a booking?
items.answer: You can make a booking as a guest without registering. However, registration is recommended if you book frequently.

items.question: 4. How can I make a booking?
items.answer: Select the item you want on the booking page, enter the date, time and any other required details, and confirm the booking. You will receive a confirmation email once the process is complete.

items.question: 5. What information is required for a booking?
items.answer: Depending on the service, we require your name, email address, telephone number, period of use and, where applicable, the purpose of use.

items.question: 6. How do I know that my booking was successful?
items.answer: The responsible staff member will process your request and send you a confirmation email once the booking has been successfully completed.

items.question: 7. Are bookings free of charge?
items.answer: Some services are free of charge, while others are subject to a fee. The costs are displayed directly in the relevant booking offer.

items.question: 8. How does online payment work?
items.answer: If a fee applies to the service, you can conveniently pay it online by SEPA direct debit, credit card or other digital payment methods.

items.question: 9. Will I receive an invoice or receipt?
items.answer: Yes, once the payment has been completed, we will send you a payment confirmation by email.

items.question: 10. Can I change or cancel my booking afterwards?
items.answer: Yes. Your booking confirmation includes an option to cancel the booking.

items.question: 12. What happens if I do not attend my appointment?
items.answer: If you do not cancel, a fee may be charged or the booking may remain unavailable to others. Please cancel appointments in good time.

items.question: 13. What do I need to bring to the booked appointment?
items.answer: Please bring your booking confirmation, either digitally or printed, and proof of identity if required.

items.question: 14. When may I use the rooms or equipment I have booked?
items.answer: Use is permitted only during the specified period. Please keep to the agreed times to avoid overlaps.

items.question: 15. Who can I contact if I need assistance on site?
items.answer: The responsible contact person is named in the booking confirmation. For general questions, you can contact the Smart City team at smartcity@guben.de.

items.question: 16. I am experiencing technical problems while booking. What can I do?
items.answer: If the booking does not work or an error message appears, first try using a different browser. If the problem persists, contact us by email at smartcity@guben.de.
